5.3 Rigid Body

Recall that a rigid body is a system of k particles of masses m 1 , . . . , m k connected
by massless rods in such a way that their mutual distances remain constant. If in
addition we assume that a given particle is fixed (at the origin, say) then we obtain
the holonomic constraint
